words.sense: Neglecting future needs, especially through careless use of money or resources.
Showing poor judgment or taking an unwise risk in general.
misconceptions: Bad saving habits are merely generic imprudence, with no distinctive future-needs issue.

semantic_axes.description: Whether bad judgment specifically neglects future necessities.

edges.boundary_rule: Improvident choices fail to provide for later needs; imprudent choices can be unwise for any reason.
clues_a: uses savings earmarked for future needs

misconceptions.M2: Bad saving habits are merely generic imprudence, with no distinctive future-needs issue.
misconceptions.M3: A high price automatically proves a failure to plan for the future.
